title: Identify common-noun tokens
phenomenon: Find every token used as a common noun (普通名詞). Label it common_noun.

title: Extract possibility expressions
phenomenon: Find complete multi-token expressions that mark epistemic possibility. Label them epistemic_possibility.
sentences: 明日は雨かもしれない。
彼も参加するかもしれません。

title: Classify sentence-final particles
phenomenon: Find sentence-final particles. Label よ as assertion_particle and ね as confirmation_particle.

title: Distinguish existential and necessity uses
phenomenon: Find いる/ある predicates. Label a living-subject existential as animate_existence and the complete 必要がある construction as necessity_construction. Do not emit the embedded ある separately.
oracle_query:
animate_existence := [text=いる & upos=AUX].
necessity_construction := [text=必要] [text=が] [lemma=有る].

title: Extract passive predicates
phenomenon: Find the complete predicate carrying passive voice, including its inflection. Label it passive_predicate.
sentences: その本は学生に読まれた。

title: Classify の by grammatical function
phenomenon: Find each の functioning as either a nominalizer or an explanatory construction marker. Label it nominalizer or explanatory_no.
oracle_query:
nominalizer := [text=の & unidic.pos2=準体助詞] followed_by([text in {が, は, を, も, か}]).
explanatory_no := [text=の & unidic.pos2=準体助詞] followed_by([upos=AUX]).
